correctness.rationale: Single-symbol counts and homogeneous pairs/triples recover the run and singleton inventories. The 001 and 100 occurrences count the ends of long zero-runs adjacent to ones; 010 counts internal singleton one-runs. Hence the endpoint correction is recovered and, in reverse, determines both mixed bins. Balanced runs give independent one-per-symbol endpoint choices; imbalanced runs require two distinct majority runs, giving the stated feasible number of long endpoints. An all-singleton inventory has one length; otherwise each length from its minimum occurs. Summing the three majority endpoint cases separately and then the geometric series reproduces the rational function. Differentiated geometric series for n, n², n³ and n⁴ plus the residue terms reproduce the fraction exactly, including the exceptional n=1. One representative per class attains the code bound. Private replay: `python /workspace/independent_checks_1_4.py 2` also confirms literal observation counts at n=1..15. Finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.
